reworked_diffusion_policy.train

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.train

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

.. py:function:: _apply_overrides(cfg: ml_collections.ConfigDict) -> ml_collections.ConfigDict

   Apply CLI flag overrides on top of the resolved configuration.

   :param cfg: Configuration produced by :func:`get_config`.

   :returns: Updated configuration reflecting any CLI overrides.


.. py:function:: _to_device(batch: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], device: torch.device) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]

   Move every tensor in ``batch`` to ``device`` using non-blocking copies.

   :param batch: Mini-batch mapping field names to tensors.
   :param device: Destination device.

   :returns: Dictionary containing tensors located on ``device``.


.. py:function:: build_dataloaders(cfg: ml_collections.ConfigDict)

   Construct dataset and data loaders based on ``cfg``.

   :param cfg: Training configuration.

   :returns: Tuple ``(dataset, train_loader, eval_loader)``.


.. py:function:: build_model(cfg: ml_collections.ConfigDict) -> reworked_diffusion_policy.models.diffusion_policy.DiffusionPolicy

   Instantiate the diffusion policy from the configuration tree.

   :param cfg: Training configuration.

   :returns: Configured :class:`DiffusionPolicy` instance.


.. py:function:: evaluate(model: reworked_diffusion_policy.models.diffusion_policy.DiffusionPolicy, dataloader: torch.utils.data.DataLoader, device: torch.device, cfg: ml_collections.ConfigDict, *, wandb_run=None, epoch: int | None = None) -> float

   Evaluate ``model`` over ``dataloader`` and return the mean MSE.

   :param model: Policy to evaluate.
   :param dataloader: Data loader providing evaluation batches.
   :param device: Target device for tensors.
   :param cfg: Configuration controlling evaluation side-effects.
   :param wandb_run: Optional active Weights & Biases run.
   :param epoch: Optional epoch index for logging.

   :returns: Mean squared error aggregated over the evaluation set.


.. py:function:: train(argv) -> None

   Entry point used by both ``absl.app`` and :mod:`sphinx` automation.

   :param argv: Command-line arguments supplied by :mod:`absl`.


.. py:function:: main(argv) -> None

   Wrapper that mirrors ``absl.app`` expectations.

   :param argv: Raw CLI arguments from :mod:`absl.app`.
